info.title: Epoch Platform Files and Space
info.description: The Files and Space API, owned by Platform (ENG-2819). Original references and bytes stay immutable. Space opens the latest saved version; imports/citations pin a returned immutable file_ref. These operations perform no AI work.

x-epoch-file-transfer-error-codes.FILE_DIRECT_TRANSFER_UNAVAILABLE: No signed links for this session: send its parts through PUT /api/v1/files/{file_ref}/content.
x-epoch-file-transfer-error-codes.FILE_UPLOAD_STORED: The content is already stored: complete the upload.
x-epoch-file-transfer-error-codes.FILE_UPLOAD_INACTIVE: The upload session expired or was replaced: initialize the upload again.

x-epoch-file-edit-error-codes.FILE_EDIT_CONFLICT: Keep the draft; reload/review the latest version before a new save.
x-epoch-file-edit-error-codes.FILE_EDIT_IN_PROGRESS: Retain the exact request_id/body and retry to reconcile the original save.
x-epoch-file-edit-error-codes.FILE_EDIT_REQUEST_REUSED: This key belongs to a different edit. A new edit needs a new key. The same edit sent inline or staged is the same save.
x-epoch-file-edit-error-codes.FILE_EDIT_EXPIRED: The previous attempt is fenced. A new explicit save may use a new key.
x-epoch-file-edit-error-codes.FILE_EDIT_BUSY: No save was reserved. Retry the same key after Retry-After.
x-epoch-file-edit-error-codes.FILE_EDIT_UNAVAILABLE: The result may be uncertain. Retain the exact key/body and retry.
x-epoch-file-edit-error-codes.FILE_DIRECT_TRANSFER_UNAVAILABLE: No signed links here: send the edit inline in the save request.
x-epoch-file-edit-error-codes.FILE_EDIT_UPLOAD_MISSING: The uploaded edit expired or was never put: put it again with the same request_id, then save.

bearer.description: An ordinary owner Cognito or Epoch token. Saves require files:write for scoped credentials.

edit.description: The edit, inline. Send exactly one of edit and edit_upload.

edit_upload.description: The edit put through linkFileEditUpload (its size and SHA-256). Send exactly one of edit and edit_upload.

sort_by.description: The person's choice to sort rows by the reviewed time index (ENG-3100): exactly that index's name. Rows otherwise keep the file's order. Written and hashed only when non-empty.

transfer.description: direct asks for signed storage links (linkFileUploadPart) so parts never pass through this API. The session says which transfer it has.
Present when the request named a transfer. direct: put each part through linkFileUploadPart's link. proxied: PUT each part to upload_url.
